about.heading: About this map
about.body_1: This map is being built by and for platform workers: people working in ride-hailing, delivery, content moderation, data work, care work and more. It is a project of the Global Platform Workers Solidarity Project (GPWSP).
about.body_2: This is an early prototype. Everything shown is invented sample data. No real worker information is collected or displayed.
about.privacy_body: This site uses no cookies, no tracking and no advertising. Apart from the service that hosts this website, your device does not contact any other company when you view this map.
about.map_data: Country borders: Natural Earth (public domain). Borders are shown for reference only and are not a statement about any disputed territory.
